prompt: The deprecated (v0) Button in packages/components/Button/src/deprecated/Button.tsx does not apply its pressed-state border color override from settings. Plan the fix.

assertions.description: Identifies v0 from foundation-compose imports, not the deprecated directory alone.
Fixes the pressed override through settings layering and _overrides without bypassing mergeSettings.
Keeps the fix in v0 rather than migrating to v1 or framework-base.
